name: Rixos Phu Quoc Vietnam - Ultra All Inclusive
short_description: Rixos's first Southeast Asian resort, a 5-star ultra all-inclusive on Hon Thom Island, Phu Quoc, reached by a record-setting cable car, with 1,700 rooms.
ai_summary: Rixos Phu Quoc Vietnam - Ultra All Inclusive is a 5-star resort on palm-fringed Hon Thom Island, reached via the Guinness World Record-certified Hon Thom Cable Car -- the world's longest non-stop three-way cable car. It is Rixos's first property in Southeast Asia, with roughly 1,700 elegant rooms, multiple dining and entertainment options, and kids' clubs, run on an ultra all-inclusive model. Industry coverage (Business Traveller, TTG Asia, July 2025) reported the resort as Rixos's Southeast Asia debut, opening in phases from mid-2026. No ALL Rating is shown yet on the property's own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
